description: Load order: items in the wrong order (invalid), a first item whose order is ignored (}, which then loads after its source and hides nothing), a block whose highest module loads after the item after it (invalid), an item that is neither source nor target (-), sources without a target above them, a section name twice in a file (both read the first section's items), flags with spaces between them, and lines that are not items.
